ceu: ✦ The trine between Jupiter and Saturn

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
From {H:1806943702000}, the Moon moves into {S:0} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
From {H:1806943702000}, the Moon moves into {S:0} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
From {H:1806943702000}, the Moon moves into {S:0} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
From {H:1806943702000}, the Moon moves into {S:0} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
From {H:1806943702000}, the Moon moves into {S:0} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
From {H:1806943702000}, the Moon moves into {S:0} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
From {H:1806943702000}, the Moon moves into {S:0} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
From {H:1806943702000}, the Moon moves into {S:0} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
From {H:1806943702000}, the Moon moves into {S:0} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
From {H:1806943702000}, the Moon moves into {S:0} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
From {H:1806943702000}, the Moon moves into {S:0} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
From {H:1806943702000}, the Moon moves into {S:0} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.
